Statistics of [[Belgian First Division]] in the 1920–21 season.

It was contested by 12 teams, and [[R. Daring Club Molenbeek|Daring Club]] won the championship.<br>
As the number of clubs was to be increased from 12 to 14, only one club was relegated to the Promotion Division, with three clubs promoted.<ref name="rsssf">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesb/belghist.html |title=Belgium – Final Tables 1895–2008 |publisher=The Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation |last1=Ploquin |first1=Phil |last2=Nackaerts |first2=Luc |last3=Coolsaet |first3=Jeroen |access-date=16 December 2018}}</ref>
